coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of five ground-truth variable items are matched: fixed JaxMARL/SMAX hardware and resources, inclusion of MAPPO versus QMIX, and wall-clock time to defined performance thresholds as a convergence proxy.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design uses six scenarios rather than nine and includes a map with more than 10 units. It adds IPPO and VDN beyond the specified algorithms. Normalized return uses random/expert baseline scaling rather than score divided by the scenario maximum. Its primary training-time measure is time for a fixed step budget, although a separate time-to-threshold metric partially addresses convergence timing.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: It omits both expected findings: PPO training approximately 6× faster than Q-learning and outperforming it in normalized score across most SMAX scenarios due to greater training stability and more effective policy optimization.
